source.production_scope: native-f32 scaled complex multiplication helper only; f64 traversal and arithmetic are unchanged

sample_design.initial_block: 3 triplets per q, q1 followed by q8

sample_design.paired_ratio: candidate median batch time divided by parent median batch time within each process triplet

current_head_ducc_baseline.comparison_limit: Candidate results are exact-parent paired timing only; do not treat these ratios as a new candidate/DUCC matched measurement.
